title: true pricing – guiding consumers within a new pricing paradigm
core_idea: True pricing internalizes external costs into final selling prices and the study aims to understand how to communicate these prices at the point of sale. Using a large-scale survey experiment with 1,400 Dutch and Danish consumers, the research compares presentation formats (absolute, relative, or no information) to assess effects on consumer choice and inform price-presentation practices.
tldr: Investigates how different presentation formats for 'true prices'—which internalize external costs—affect consumer decision-making using a large survey experiment, to guide marketing communication and implementation.
